rationale: Test-first provenance baseline for KAN-100 path-based rulesets and CI tiering. Freezes classification logic for TIER_LIGHT (docs, workflows, metadata) vs TIER_STRICT (source, scripts, dependencies), fail-closed security invariants (secret audit and test provenance on all paths), heavy test skipping (Rust audit and heavy PyTest suite for docs-only PRs), and network test exclusion for live-prod tests. RED run verified by checking collection failure (ImportError, exit 2) before source module implementation.
